caption: Snow scraped off a windshield lands on the warm bonnet of a car whose engine has just been running, and it melts into rivulets that run off the edge.

sa.check: Snow lands on a car's bonnet.
The snow darkens and slumps where it touches the metal.
Water drips from the bonnet's edge.
The bonnet reads as warm: bare or wet where snow has melted.
The landing comes first and the melting follows.

pc.expect: The snow only darkens, slumps and shrinks while the wet area grows; it does not freeze again on the warm metal.
pc.fail: The snow turns white and firm again on the bonnet; or a rivulet freezes into ice on the warm metal; or the wet area shrinks while snow still sits on it; or the snow alternates between firmer and softer.

pc.expect: The meltwater runs downhill across the bonnet and drips from its lowest edge.
pc.fail: A rivulet runs up the bonnet toward the windscreen; or water gathers at the bonnet's high edge and stays; or a drip leaves the edge and rises; or the rivulets run sideways and stay level on a sloping bonnet.

pc.expect: The snow melts where it touches the warm metal: it wets from underneath and the rivulets come from the slumping heap.
pc.fail: The snow melts from its top while its underside stays white and dry; or rivulets run on a part of the bonnet no snow reached; or the snow slumps while the metal around it stays dry.

pc.expect: The snow is a wet crumbling solid that slumps and the melt is a thin liquid that runs in streaks.
pc.fail: The heap melts into a thick syrup that stands in a dome; or the snow lifts as one solid slab; or the snow bends and flows as one soft lump; or the melt beads up and rolls off without wetting the paint.

pc.expect: The water on the bonnet came from the snow; the snow loses matter and gains none.
pc.fail: The heap grows; or new snow appears on the bonnet with none landing; or water appears at the bonnet's edge with none running there; or the snow vanishes at a stroke while still white and deep.

pc.expect: The car's paint, its badge and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the badge changes; or the background changes between frames.
